stem:
In her school science laboratory, Anjali beats a thin copper strip with a hammer. The copper strip ……1……, so copper is said to be malleable.

She then beats a piece of sulfur with the same hammer. The sulfur ……2……, so sulfur is said to be brittle.

Which words correctly complete gaps 1 and 2?

options.text: 1 flattens into a sheet; 2 flattens into a sheet
1 flattens into a sheet; 2 breaks into pieces
1 breaks into pieces; 2 flattens into a sheet
1 breaks into pieces; 2 breaks into pieces

tables: {"headers":["","1","2"],"rows":[["A","flattens into a sheet","flattens into a sheet"],["B","flattens into a sheet","breaks into pieces"],["C","breaks into pieces","flattens into a sheet"],["D","breaks into pieces","breaks into pieces"]],"row_labels":["A","B","C","D"],"caption":"","is_option_table":true}

teacher.key_rationale: Copper is a metal and flattens into a sheet when hammered (malleability); sulfur is a non-metal and breaks into pieces when hammered (brittleness). Therefore gap 1 = 'flattens into a sheet' and gap 2 = 'breaks into pieces', giving option B.
